review_rules: These are proposed appearance prompts, not new image annotations or verified diagnostic descriptions.
Review against class definitions and training images only before locking; do not optimize on the final evaluation set.
Hollowareas especially needs review of visible inspection markings and dataset label meaning. RGB images do not establish internal delamination.
WConccor retains the official final object-group channel despite its damage-like name.
Check tokenizer lengths with the selected CLIP tokenizer before computing the 57 cached text embeddings.
For the class-name baseline, repeat class_name_prompt three times; for static averaging use equal weights over description scores.
